name: Grade a batch of submissions (Jev judge)

parameters.content:
## Grade many submissions at once

Each row is graded on its own: code checks first, then TypeSafe (Jev) answers the rubric with full probabilities. Every item leaves with its verdict and a receipt.

For a sheet: read rows with Google Sheets, and write `jev.verdict` and `jev.receipt.receiptHash` back after each exit. Your own TypeSafe key only.
